newsitem.title: USA: Aluminum stocks look set to begin falling - Alumax.
newsitem.headline: Aluminum stocks look set to begin falling - Alumax.

text.p: Aluminum inventories are set to fall over the coming two years with the market moving to slight supply deficits with some planned expansion projects falling by the wayside, Parker Dodds, director of corporate planning and development at Alumax Inc said.

"The message is, overall, that the future is faintly bright," Dodds told the Institute of Scrap Recycling Industries aluminum round table here. "I don't think there is a serious supply and demand imbalance."
Alumax is one of the world's biggest aluminum producers.
